title: CSS Gradient Demonstration
summary: A per-visit gradient painting whose wall label is the exact, executable CSS that paints it — the recipe and the work are one object, and there is no original file.
mechanism: A random linear-gradient() string is applied verbatim as the painting's background and displayed as its own complete, byte-identical reproduction recipe; client-side, no network.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
net.art (the CSS paint pipeline as material)
